lines.text: This is Local Cognitive: private AI on your own machines.
Chat with models that run on your own computer. Prompts and answers stay there.
Pick a model from Hugging Face. Memory is checked before the download.
Chain agents, files and commands, and watch every step run.
Synthesis writes code against a contract, and real tests decide when it is done.
Or run it on your own GPU server, end-to-end encrypted.
